text_block_list.text:
The following day, having safely made it back to
the academy with Gold Ship—
(Murmuring and buzzing...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand we're live at the racetrack.
Reporting is everyone's favorite, Golshi-chan.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
First up, an ambush interview with our rookie Trainer! ☆
Tell us, how are you feeling about today's big race?
choice_data_list: So today really was the race...
So today really was the race after all...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Buzzkill Jones, you're ruining the bit.
I told you like ten times that it was, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I need your help out here today, so get your head in the game.
You know you need a Trainer to run in the Twinkle Series, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I managed to bluff my way through registration without one,
but that stunt definitely wasn't gonna fly today.
choice_data_list: So you're saying... any Trainer would've done?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! ...You seriously still haven't figured out
why I picked you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're always standing in the corner of the training course,
staring at us Umamusume while we run, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Rain or shine, day in and day out, with that look of dead-set conviction...
And when I saw that, it hit me—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: 'Man, this guy's got way too much free time on his hands.'

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aw, chin up! Your reactions are gold, you roll with the punches, and I actually kinda like you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Oops, looks like it's about time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, time to unleash all that built-up frustration in style!
Keep your eyeballs glued to meee!!
Despite being dragged through the wringer, watching Gold Ship walk off made me wonder what kind of race she was about to run.
And then, the gates opened for Gold Ship's debut race!
She got off to a decent start and held a solid position as the race unfolded—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the final bend, they enter the homestretch!
The frontrunner is pulling away! Is this race decided?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAHHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Gold Ship with an explosive surge from behind!
Three lengths to the lead! Now one length!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She takes the lead right at the wire—GOOOAL!!!!
Gold Ship claims a spectacular victory in her debut race!

What an exhilarating race...!
I was completely captivated by her running.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
HELL YEAAAHHHH!
VICTORYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How's that for raw talent?!
Now that's what Golshi-chan's running is all about~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Faster than anyone else! Stealing the spotlight and taking the win!
That's the true essence of Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the look on your face, you had a blast!
Best expression you've made yet!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So, we're good to keep going as Trainer and runner, right?!
I had a nagging feeling I'd been cleverly tricked, but there was no denying the thrill of watching Gold Ship run, so—
choice_data_list: Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let us protect the peace of mankind together!!
And so, her debut race came to a triumphant close, and I officially became Gold Ship's Trainer, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
GYAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!
I'm totally running low on frustratiooon!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How many days until the next race?!
Three days?! Two days?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A-At this rate, I won't have enough burning spirit,
and I might not be able to run properly...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Which means it's treasure hunting time! Treasure hunt!!
Let's embark on a journey to find the ultimate source of frustration—!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Next stop: OUTER SPACEEEEE!!
HERE WE GOOOOOOOOOOO—!!
I had to desperately scramble to keep Gold Ship from attempting to launch herself into space...

Wild, boisterous, and unmatched by anyone—Gold Ship.
Being her Trainer was clearly going to take a whole lot of work.
— Gold Ship: Earth Arc - END —
